notes.title: Hint System Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34930804/d6ba9da4ed944cb7f40568df78e4df935c1566a4.jpg[/img]

Hello Steam Players! I added an optional hint system  to the game
to help players solve the puzzles.

Thank you very much for playing, take care and have fun!

P.S I am sorry the angel is rude this time, but he will suck your pockets dry!!!
